How does one go about making their own microscope? Is it a kit?

I took two pairs of quality binoculars to pieces and experimentally hand ground the lenses into different shapes. I wrecked 6 lenses before I was reasonably happy with the 7th. It isn't perfect, there's some fuzziness so I will try to refine the grind with lens 8.

I then used one pair of binoculars as a mounting station for the lens and the light. The lighting has been pretty tricky as it needs an intense beam in a small area but the scope sits about 3mm above the subject and only has a depth of field of about 3mm so squeezing the light beam in there was a bit of a mission.

The other problem was and is dust. Fuck me it's hard keeping stuff clean on such a tiny scale :)

It's probably also difficult to keep yourself from huffing the air dusters instead of using them for their intended purpose.
